description: Original transitive_closure mod.rs with bounded correspondence models.
state: Ordered directed adjacency lists of usize targets; at most 8192 vertices and one million arcs; complete Result of private packed reflexive reachability plus queries.
cost: O(V² ceil(V/64)+E) time; O(V ceil(V/64)) persistent storage and one row scratch. Limits bound packed storage; allocation failure remains outside typed errors.
forward: Check size limits then every target in adjacency order. Initialize diagonal and arcs in u64 words; for k in vertex order, clone row k and OR it into each row containing bit k. reachable(u,v) returns None for either invalid endpoint, else the stored bit.
inverse: Let U be declared inputs crossed with returned observations and R the forward relation in model.md#approximant. C=U minus R includes wrong first errors, wrong values and forbidden results. This is an exact specification complement and partial source-derived model, not a measured global Rust complement. After pivot k, bits represent walks with internal vertices among 0..k. All diagonal bits stay set. Padding bits stay zero. Final relation is reflexive and transitive, contains every arc and is minimal with these properties.

Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} retains all compatible inputs. Outputs lose redundant edges and intermediate heap/pivot traces; errors retain all graphs sharing their first-failure condition. No unique recovery or inverse executor is claimed.
limitations: Finite evidence is not a general proof; allocation failures unmodeled.
Partial syntax excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution.
